title: Essential Minimalist Full Body Timesaver
author: Florian Zieseniß
desc: This timesaving full body minimalist program for intermediates focuses on the essential compound movements to build size and strength and fills the gaps with a few key isolation exercises. Train closer to failure to make this lower volume approach work. After 4 weeks simply restart the program with increased weights. Utilize a deload week inbetween if needed. Make sure you do multiple warmup sets before any heavy compound movements.
